verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials claim this story directly. They describe auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe with AI-filled memos and categories (ramp-docs-1), and automatic transaction categorization from transaction details, history and team feedback, with coded transactions synced to the ERP (ramp-docs-15). Dedicated auto-coding agents automate the work 'from collecting receipts to drafting memos', and the CLI exposes receipts upload/attach plus transactions memo-suggestions and missing-item handling. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how receipts are actually captured and matched at swipe time, and independent or hands-on confirmation that capture and coding happen with no manual entry (the evidence is marketing-level only).
